### Problem

The release lane cannot pass while the engine recognises the test identity by a login written in the pack instead of the login of the token it actually uses, so v7.14.0 cannot be tagged.

### Scope

Reading the test identity's login from its token's owner where the lane runs, and using that one value in scripts/org.py, scripts/policy.py, scripts/deciders.py and scripts/sync-repos.py; kinds/engine-test/pack.yml keeps only `secret`; the self-tests and docs/configuration.md.

### Out of scope

Replacing the token's account with a GitHub App. The triage marking a scenario issue as a duplicate (#740's `bug-not-reproduced`).

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a `DX_TEST_TOKEN` whose owner is any login, when the lane works out the test identity, then its login is that owner's, read from GitHub, and no login is written in the pack.
C2: Given a scenario pull request in the test repository authored by the token's owner, when the auto-merge decision runs, then it is a trusted author there and nowhere else.
C3: Given an `accepted` added by the token's owner in the test repository, when the deciders are worked out, then it counts there and is refused in any other repository.
C4: Given the self-tests of org.py, policy.py, deciders.py and sync-repos.py, when they run, then they cover a token owner that is not `{org}-test-bot`.

### Criticality

Normal
